pageQuotes.excerpt: London Venture Capital Firm for European Pre-Seed Investment | Playfair Portfolio Thesis Team Story Content Pre-seed Resources Careers Pitch Us We play fair by founders Investing exclusively at pre-seed in the UK & Europe from our £57m Fund 3, we give you an unfair advantage, taking you from where you are to where you want to be We partner with visionary founders, with hustle, heart and humility, who see the world not as it is, but as it could be, and together build durable foundations for growth Our pre-seed to Series A graduation rate is 78% - ~4x the industry average Since 2013, our founders have raised >$3bn of follow-on capital from the world's best specialist and multi-stage funds. Most recently: $37m Series B Kinnevik $72.5m Series B BPC $36m Series B Hedosophia $17m Series A DCVC $20m Series A GV We are highly selective, making 6 investments per year. When we agree to invest, we are all in and will give you as much time and energy as you need to succeed 60% of the fund is reserved for follow-on and we will support you through Series A. We have the capacity to invest up to £5m per company Our goal is simple: ensure you have the right support to build your company into a global category leader We co-invest in 100% of our new investments, optimising for the best combination of funds and angels, writing cheques from £100k for angel rounds to £1.5m for the largest pre-seed
